name: blur-focus
title: Blur Focus
description: Words sharpen from a soft blur into focus, one after another, as the line enters the screen.

meta.reducedMotion: Text is sharp and visible from the start.
meta.useWhen: The concept is about clarity, focus, eyesight, photography or waking up.
meta.avoidWhen: Every heading on the page; long paragraphs; low-end devices with many instances.
